body: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.
summaryZh: 技能作为推理时添加的可重用程序化指导，能够显著提升大模型的下游性能。然而以往研究多通过语义相关性检索技能，忽视了单个技能的实际效用。本文指出在在线蒸馏中仅有少于25%的检索技能能提供有效的学习信号，并据此提出了SGUID方法，用于选择紧凑的技能子集进行蒸馏。SGUID仅保留在训练中持续产出有效学习信号的技能。实验表明，通过SGUID选择少量技能进行蒸馏，其效果能够匹配甚至超越全量技能库蒸馏，同时支持稳定的模型-技能协同进化，有效避免了直接使用未过滤技能所带来的性能下降问题。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出SGUID技能选择方法，通过精准挑选紧凑的技能库进行模型蒸馏，实现了模型与技能的稳定协同进化。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种用于选择紧凑技能库以实现模型-技能协同进化的算法方法
技能蒸馏，指将推理时的可重用技能转化为模型内部能力的过程
在线策略蒸馏，指利用当前策略生成的样本或路径进行知识蒸馏的训练方式
模型-技能协同进化，指模型能力提升与技能库不断更新优化之间的闭环演进过程
技能库，存储可重用程序化提示词或推理指导的集合
